name: bitwarden-feature-flag-unwinder
description: Autonomous feature-flag unwinder scoped to one repo per invocation. Give it a flag key and a lifecycle step (and optionally a Jira ticket to link and comment on); it removes the flagged code, verifies build + tests, and opens one PR against the current repo. Engineers dispatch it locally ("clean up feature flag pm-1234-flag" fans out one background session per repo), and a workflow in ai-plugins runs it per target repo (clients, server, ios, android), biweekly from Jira or on demand.
